# Spellophone 0.2.1

The included browser build and English speech data come from the released
`@spelling-creator/spellophone@0.2.1` package. They are distributed under
GPL-3.0-or-later. See the accompanying LICENSE file.

- [Corresponding source and build files](https://github.com/Spelling-Creator/spellophone/tree/v0.2.1)
- [Upstream source archive](https://github.com/Spelling-Creator/spellophone/archive/refs/tags/v0.2.1.tar.gz)
- [Original npm release](https://registry.npmjs.org/@spelling-creator/spellophone/-/spellophone-0.2.1.tgz)

Only the browser runtime, its source maps, and the data required for English
synthesis are included. The practice page loads them when the built-in voice
is used.
